decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already replaces the About page process copy with the revised Small and Big Block prize parameters.
A complete same-message MODIFY already updates the FAQ block-prize descriptions while preserving the unchanged pool-funding statement.
A complete same-message MODIFY already changes the Small Block to one $500 winner after every 100 qualifying sales.
A complete same-message MODIFY already changes the Big Block to one winner every 10,000 sales; the $10,000 per-winner amount remains unchanged.
Changing the Small Block winner count and sales cadence does not change ticket issuance, weighting, eligibility relative to the prior draw, reset behavior, or transfer rules.
The source changes prize size and draw cadence but explicitly preserves the net giveaway amount and does not alter primary-mint allocations or funding sources.
Changing the Big Block winner count and sales cadence does not change ticket issuance, weighting, cohort eligibility, reset behavior, or transfer rules.
The source does not change which ticket counters, badges, or referral-code attributes must appear in NFT metadata.
The source changes prize amounts, winner counts, and cadence but does not resolve or alter the claim-versus-automatic payout method.
The revised draw parameters do not change the enabled royalty, flat $10 amount, visibility, or ongoing use of royalty proceeds to fund prize pools.
The source does not change which NFT data, badges, referral code, book access, or active and expired tickets transfer on a secondary sale.
Message 158 changes only prize parameters and does not remove or modify Aave yield behavior; the later message about Aave is outside the source Event.
